title: How Long, O Lord?

questions.question: How long, O Lord? Will you forget me for how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:1 (ESV): "How long, O Lord? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?"

questions.question: How long must I take counsel in my soul and have sorrow in my heart when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:2 (ESV): "How long must I take counsel in my soul and have sorrow in my heart all the day?"

questions.question: Consider and answer me, O Lord my God; light up my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:3 (ESV): "...light up my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death,"

questions.question: But I have trusted in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:5 (ESV): "But I have trusted in your steadfast love;"

questions.question: I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt how with me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:6 (ESV): "I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt bountifully with me."

questions.question: Lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed over him," lest my foes rejoice because I am what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:4 (ESV): "...lest my foes rejoice because I am shaken."

questions.question: My heart shall rejoice in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:5 (ESV): "...my heart shall rejoice in your salvation."

questions.question: How long will you hide your face from me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:1 (ESV): "How long will you hide your face from me?" (Psalm of David)

questions.question: How long shall my enemy be exalted over whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:2 (ESV): "How long shall my enemy be exalted over me?"

questions.question: Who is the author of this Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13 Title: "To the choirmaster. A Psalm of David."

questions.question: Light up my eyes means what in this context?
questions.explanation: Implies reviving from the brink of death ("lest I sleep the sleep of death").

questions.question: How many times does the phrase "How long" appear in verses 1-2?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13:1-2 (ESV): "How long... How long... How long... How long..." (4 times).

questions.question: What emotion dominates the beginning of the Psalm?
questions.explanation: Context of "How long... sorrow in my heart".

questions.question: What emotion dominates the end of the Psalm?
questions.explanation: Context of "But I have trusted... my heart shall rejoice... I will sing".

questions.question: This Psalm is directed to the Choirmaster. True or False?
questions.explanation: Psalm 13 Title: "To the choirmaster. A Psalm of David."

key_verse_text: But I have trusted in your steadfast love; my heart shall rejoice in your salvation. I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt bountifully with me.
